verified: edh-c-49 review (Commander effort, EDHREC rank 16538; held-out, opened by the owner (commander request 2026-10-27, more cards 2026-10-30)), by hand against the Oracle text, the Scryfall ruling (2021-11-19: each reduction applies on its own, so a Spirit and an enchantment make it cost {2} less) and the Comprehensive Rules (media.wizards.com text 2026-09-25): ~ costs {1} less to cast if you control a Spirit (cm.self.less.if) and, as a second static ability of the spell on the stack with its own condition, it also costs {1} less if you control an enchantment (cm.edhv49.self.also.less.if; lower/ability.ts splits the paragraph into one static per sentence only when every sentence states a condition and the same zone, CR 601.2f, 118.7, 604.1); counter target spell unless its controller pays {3} (wrap.payelse, eff.counter, CR 701.6a, 118.12).

edh-c-49 review (Commander effort, EDHREC rank 16963; held-out, opened by the owner (commander request 2026-10-27, more cards 2026-10-30)), by hand against the Oracle text, the Scryfall rulings (2014-02-01: abilities of creature cards not on the battlefield can't target it either; if control changes the protection is from creatures controlled by the opponents of its NEW controller) and the Comprehensive Rules (media.wizards.com text 2026-09-25): target creature you control gains protection from creatures your opponents control until end of turn (quality opp:type:Creature: the source is a creature AND its controller is an opponent of the protected permanent's CURRENT controller, which is the ruling; rules/protection.ts#sourceHasQuality, CR 702.16a-b), then untap it (CR 701.26a).

edh-c-49 review (Commander effort, EDHREC rank 16677; tuning half), by hand against the Oracle text and the Comprehensive Rules (media.wizards.com text 2026-09-25; the card has no Scryfall ruling): {1}{B},{T}: target opponent discards a card, then if that player has no cards in hand, flip (existing templates); the other face, at the beginning of each opponent's upkeep that player loses 1 life for each card fewer than three in their hand (eff.edhv49.player.loseLife.perCardFewerThanThreeInHand: max(0, 3 minus the cards in THAT player's hand), so no life is lost, nor gained, with three or more cards, CR 119.3, 402.1, 608.2h).

edh-c-49 review (Commander effort, EDHREC rank 16752; tuning half), by hand against the Oracle text, the Scryfall rulings (2022-09-09: enlist is chosen as attackers are declared; it triggers when its controller taps another creature for its enlist) and the Comprehensive Rules (media.wizards.com text 2026-09-25): Enlist (keyword); whenever ~ enlists a creature, scry 2 (event action enlist of the object itself, emitted by core/attack-options.ts when the controller taps a creature for that creature's enlist, CR 702.154a, 603.2); discard a card: ~ gains indestructible until end of turn, tap it (existing templates).

edh-c-49 review (Commander effort, EDHREC rank 16977; tuning half), by hand against the Oracle text and the Comprehensive Rules (media.wizards.com text 2026-09-25; the card has no Scryfall ruling): until end of turn, whenever a player gains life, that player (the player of the gain event) loses twice the amount of that life gain (eff.edhv49.player.loseLife.twicePerLifeGained: math 2 times the event amount, a delayed trigger that lasts the turn, CR 119.3, 603.2, 603.7, 608.2h): gaining 3 life nets -3.

edh-c-49 review (Commander effort, EDHREC rank 16962; held-out, opened by the owner (commander request 2026-10-27, more cards 2026-10-30)), by hand against the Oracle text, the Scryfall ruling (2014-11-07: the damage is dealt simultaneously; if all players are at 0 or less life the game is a draw) and the Comprehensive Rules (media.wizards.com text 2026-09-25): for each player, ~ deals damage to that player and to each creature that player controls equal to the number of creatures THAT player controls (eff.edhv49.forEachPlayer.damageThemAndTheirCreatures.equalCreatures: one damage step with the player and an `also` group, the count read once per player, the same number to both, CR 608.2f, 120.2b, 608.2h); the whole spell resolves before state-based actions, so the draw ruling holds.
